sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN standard ID filter configuration register (FDCAN_SIDFC)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.20 "FDCAN standard ID filter configuration register (FDCAN_SIDFC)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3700.
sections.section_content:
Settings for 11-bit standard message ID filtering.The standard ID filter configuration register
controls the filter path for standard messages as described in Figure962.
Address offset: 0x0084
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:24 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 23:16 LSS[7:0]: List size standard
0: No standard message ID filter
1-128: Number of standard message ID filter elements
>128: Values greater than 128 are interpreted as 128.
These are write-protected bits, write access is possible only when bit CCE and bit INIT of
FDCAN_CCCR register are set to 1.
Bits 15:2 FLSSA[13:0]: Filter list standard start address
Start address of standard message ID filter list (32-bit word address, see Table714).These are write-
protected bits, write access is possible only when bit CCE and bit INIT of FDCAN_CCCR register are
set to 1.
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
